exact_statement: WECA may select weights from tuning data and retains finite-sample coverage when those weights are independent of inference e-values and the test point.
paper_anchor: arXiv:2606.03600v1, Equation WECA, following proposition, and Appendix Theoretical Validity of WECA
assumptions: omega* is in the simplex and is a function only of tuning data
test point is independent of tuning data
test point is exchangeable with each inference split
final e-values are constructed only from inference splits
